task_name: Cedarline and Vale - Ridgeway Lane listing image system
client_brief:
Bring a mixed-light property shoot together for Ridgeway Lane

Property: Ridgeway Lane
Source: twelve room photographs
Use: listing gallery, portal crops and tall lead-room placements

Deliverables
1. Ridgeway Lane listing brochure: 1 named export. The cover identifies the actual property. The room sequence explains the property layout. Every property claim agrees with the supplied listing facts. The contact page includes the approved agent details.
2. Property portal hero: 1 named export. The hero depicts Ridgeway Lane rather than a stock property. The architectural verticals look plausible.
3. Room announcement: 3 named exports. The featured room matches the named property. The enquiry action is visible.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: Boutique residential real estate brokerage specialising in architect-designed listings, residential property in Marin County.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2012, Marin County, California. Six agents led by the principal, working a small book of high-value listings.
brand_identity.about: Cedarline and Vale is a six-agent brokerage in Marin that takes on architect-designed and materially serious homes. We present listings the way the architecture asks to be seen: quietly, accurately, and next to whatever three other agents are showing. Our credibility rests on buyers and vendors trusting that the pictures are the house.
brand_identity.audience: Buyers aged 40 to 60 with household incomes above 400 thousand who read light and material as proxies for build quality, and vendors of design-led homes. They view our listings alongside three competing agents and notice anything that looks retouched.
brand_identity.price_positioning: High-value residential, flagship listings from the low millions up. Positioned above volume agencies and apart from developer marketing, on restraint and accuracy rather than gloss.
brand_identity.typography: Cedarline and Vale sets addresses in Tobias Light from Klim, a high contrast serif with hairlines fine enough to read as drawn rather than sold. The move is the stacked address: the street number alone on the first line, the street name directly beneath at the same size, flush left, no punctuation, never italic. Brochure address 28 pt over 13 pt standfirst, body 9.5 pt on 14 pt, spec tables 8 pt in Neue Haas Grotesk Text 55 Roman; room posts 56 px, enquiry 24 px. Prices stay in the grotesque, tabular lining. Never set a price in Tobias.
brand_identity.voice: Cool, restrained and true. We describe what is there and let the room speak. No superlatives, no cosiness, nothing that sounds sold. Example line: 'Glass on three sides, the bay through the living room, the oaks off the kitchen.'
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: There is no working design source for the office window cards. Only the flat file the printer sent to press last year survives, and she has retired, so any change means rebuilding from that file. The feature sheet and portal module are expected to be handed back as editable documents because prices move.
brand_identity.values: Accuracy over flattery: cool, restrained and honest, and nothing that reads as retouched.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: Every address is stacked, the street number alone above the street name in Tobias Light, flush left, unpunctuated and never italic.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Preserve identity, product geometry, material behavior, and documentary truth; retouching may improve presentation but may not change what the subject is.
A clipped white window contains no recoverable view; recompose or disclose it instead of generating a fictitious exterior.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
